name: Shiganshina District
description: The southernmost district of Wall Maria and Eren's hometown. Its outer gate faces the world and its inner gate faces Wall Rose — which is why it was chosen for the first breach.

name: Trost District
description: A garrison district south of Wall Rose and the site of humanity's first victory. Its streets are a maze of sloped roofs, perfect for ODM manoeuvres and terrible for cavalry.

name: Karanes District
description: An eastern district of Wall Rose. The Survey Corps' 57th expedition passed through its gate into the territory where the Female Titan was waiting.

name: Krolva District
description: A western district of Wall Rose. Its evacuation routes became a bottleneck during the second breach scare of 850.

name: Utgard Castle
description: A ruined castle inside Wall Rose. The 104th held it overnight against the Beast Titan's Pure Titans and learned who among them was never a soldier.

name: Ehrmich District
description: The southern district of Wall Sina and the staging ground for the Survey Corps' departure to Shiganshina. Its refugee camps held the survivors of Wall Maria for five years.

name: Stohess District
description: A wealthy district of the interior and the site of the Female Titan's capture. Beneath its streets, Annie Leonhart has been crystallised for four years.

name: Mitras
description: The royal capital at the centre of the walls. The Reiss chapel beneath it hid the founding family, the truth of the walls and a cavern full of titans.

name: Paradis Island
description: The island where Karl Fritz took his people. Three walls, one ocean, and a world that considered everyone inside them a threat for a century.

name: Liberio
description: The Eldian internment zone in Marley where Grisha, Zeke, Reiner and Gabi were raised. Willy Tybur's festival turned it into a battlefield in a single night.

name: Fort Salta
description: Marley's last defensive line and the final battlefield. The alliance, the warriors and the Founder meet here while the Rumbling reaches the horizon.
